video_title: Has Bitcoin Already Formed a Top?

claims.speaker: host
claims.reasoning_summary: The rally from the July low is a five-wave move that broke above the May high, the first higher high since the October sell-off, so the trend is now up; above the 50-week SMA and the May high (~83K).
counterarguments: not necessarily a bull market; all-time highs cannot be confirmed yet
claims.evidence_text: And now we have for the first time a fivewave move up, which means the trend is now up instead of down.

claims.speaker: host
claims.condition: if we get a pullback (a corrective wave B or wave two)

claims.evidence_text: At least I like to see a pullback if we get one. And the sooner the better. Um then I will consider to buy this pullback which I would label as a wave B or a wave two.

claims.speaker: host

claims.evidence_text: So, we're now end of September. So, we could really get a pullback into October.

claims.speaker: host
